summary.ru: Синяя Орда, или Кок-Орда — восточная часть Золотой Орды. Соответствовало территории Западной Сибири и современного Казахстана.
summary.en: The Blue Horde was a crucial component of the Mongol Empire established after Genghis Khan's demise in 1227. Functioning as the eastern part of the split Golden Horde, it contrasted with the White Horde's western segment, adhering to the Mongolian and Turkic tradition of cardinal direction colors.
